annotation.interpretation_b: Use the transport version defined by the transport protocol’s own versioning scheme, which may not match the HTTP draft number (e.g., draft-ietf-quic-http-25 could use transport draft-ietf-quic-transport-24).
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify how to determine the corresponding transport version, leaving the mapping undefined and thus incomplete for implementation.
